proposals.before: He was the youngest son of Wei Gongxuan, Duke of Wei, who had served as chief councilor under Emperor Xuanzong.
proposals.after: He was the youngest son of Cui Xuan, Duke of Wei, who had served as chief councilor in the Dazhong era.
proposals.reason: Chinese 魏公鉉 is Duke of Wei, Xuan (Cui Xuan), not a fused personal name Wei Gongxuan.

proposals.before: The minister concurred and moved him to the post of grand censor.
proposals.after: The minister concurred and moved him to the post of Grand Master of Remonstrance.
proposals.reason: 諫議大夫 is a remonstrance office, not 'grand censor' (御史).

proposals.before: According to the New Book of Tang's tables of chief ministers, the Feng clan had long resided in Raoyang County in Bohai.
proposals.after: According to the New Book of Tang's tables of chief ministers, the Feng clan had long resided in Tiao County in Bohai.
proposals.reason: 蓚縣 is Tiao County, not Raoyang (饒陽).

proposals.before: and discussed penal law with Vice Minister of War Xi Yinxiang.
proposals.after: and discussed penal law with Xi Yinxiang, Vice Minister of War.
proposals.reason: Candidate/parsing 'War Xi Yinxiang' shows the office and name were fused awkwardly; keep name intact.

decisions.reason: Focus unit 大中時宰相魏公鉉之幼子也 titles the father as 魏公 plus given name 鉉, not a fused Wei Gongxuan; surrounding 崔沂 supplies the surname Cui. Timing is the era name 大中時, not an invented Emperor Xuanzong. The proposed wording matches that parsing.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 大中時宰相魏公鉉之幼子也

decisions.reason: Focus unit moves him 移為諫議大夫; that office is Grand Master of Remonstrance, not a censorate post (御史). The later 御史司憲 posting in s0030 confirms the distinction. The proposed title corrects the mistranslation.
Focus unit places the Feng clan in 渤海蓚縣; 蓚縣 is Tiao County, not Raoyang (饒陽). The proposed place name restores the Chinese toponym.
Focus unit 與兵部侍郎郗殷象論刑法事 is already clear in the before text as Vice Minister of War Xi Yinxiang; reordering the title and name is stylistic only and does not fix a semantic error.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 與兵部侍郎郗殷象論刑法事

claimRetractions.reason: Accepted r0001 shows Emperor Xuanzong was invented only to gloss 大中時; s0023 names the Dazhong era, not that emperor title.
Accepted r0001 removes the invented Emperor Xuanzong; no ruler is named in s0023, so this ruler role has no source support.

claimRetractions.reason: Accepted r0001 shows the Emperor Xuanzong person existed only in the bad idiomatic; s0023 supplies no such person whose sex could be claimed.
Accepted r0001 shows 大中時 dates Cui Xuan's chief-councilor service, already claimed on p010; attaching that date to an invented Emperor Xuanzong has no source support.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0003 shows English Raoyang County misread 蓚縣; the native-place claim must read Tiao County while keeping zh 渤海蓚縣 and the other claim fields.
